description: Sends the saved export compliance answers to Apple: when they need it, makes the encryption declaration in App Store Connect, uploads its document, and attaches it to the App Store version's build and the builds waiting for an answer (or the one buildId); otherwise answers "no non-exempt encryption" on those builds. Apple reviews a declaration (about two business days); Ploa attaches it to each new build it sees processed. It's the person's statement to Apple, so only a person sends it (on the Store details page) unless ploa_access says this agent is autonomous; otherwise this says where they press Send.

buildId.description: Only this build (its App Store Connect ID).

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.

name: ploa_encryption_declare
title: Send export compliance to Apple
